# SwiftHerb — LLM / crawler context

> Human-readable site summary for AI assistants and answer engines. Not a legal policy document.

## What this site is
SwiftHerb is an informational supplement discovery site focused on products sold on iHerb. It offers an AI chat for suggestions, curated catalog-style pages, articles, and brand overview templates. Content is for education and shopping navigation, not medical diagnosis or treatment.

## Primary URLs
- Home: https://swiftherb.com/
- Affiliate disclosure: https://swiftherb.com/affiliate-disclosure/
- Editorial standards: https://swiftherb.com/editorial-standards/
- Privacy: https://swiftherb.com/privacy/
- Sitemap: https://swiftherb.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://swiftherb.com/robots.txt

## Outbound commerce
Product and brand CTAs may redirect through an affiliate network (e.g. Admitad) before opening iHerb. See the Affiliate Disclosure page for the current model.

## Contact
Use the Contact page linked from the site footer when available.

## Crawling
Public content is intended to be indexable. Disallowed paths are listed in robots.txt (e.g. API-style routes if present).
